description: Search nodes by AND-combined filter: titleContains (case-insensitive substring), status (one status, or a list of statuses to get e.g. all open work in one call), type, metaKey + metaValue, parentId. All fields optional. Set omitNotes for a short list without notes and timestamps. Returns matching nodes (without their children; use parentId or getNode for those) with their parent IDs.

omitNotes.description: Leave out notes and the createdAt/updatedAt timestamps

status.description: One status, or a list of statuses to match any of (e.g. ["in-progress", "blocked"] for open work)

name: findNodes
title: Find RoadRaven nodes by structured filter
